snippet.title: Curtain - Experience a Destructive Relationship in This First-Person Narrative Game | Indie Games
snippet.description:
"CURTAIN is an interactive first-person narrative about Kaci & Ally, two queer women in a Glasgow punk band, which gives you a first hand experience of their destructive relationship."

Curtain is a pixelated first person narrative game that deals with a complex and abusive relationship. Explore the game and piece together the story from what you find: diaries, newspapers, text messages. At the same time an ever present narrator watches and comments on every thought, and the player is coercively subsumed into their world. 

Players embody Ally coming home to their apartment after a successful gig as Kaci, your partner, watches and comments on every thought and action, creating an overwhelming, stifling atmosphere

A Game by dreamfeel.

Curtain: https://dreamfeel.itch.io/curtain

-Indie Games Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLagy2HvRoiuAzcnwM4ZXB4WtIyR_HE7Hx

-Indie Horror Games Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLagy2HvRoiuCP0P02J9PPDiPm-aLYBlGW

This is a No Commentary Gameplay.
